subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this reaction-specific Socket Mode report stay open until maintainers capture live current-main reaction envelopes, or be folded into a broader Slack Socket Mode delivery investigation now?
rationale: Source and release inspection show handler support but do not prove live reaction delivery; automation cannot safely choose between Slack/Bolt non-delivery, account filtering, authorization, or broader socket liveness without maintainer-provided live diagnostics.

options.title: Keep Reaction Report Open
options.body: Use this issue as the reaction-specific tracker and request redacted live current-main envelopes, status output, and gateway trace logs before a code fix.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Work
options.body: Close or link this only after a maintainer verifies that the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery issue has the same root cause and preserves the reaction-specific evidence.

options.title: Close After Live Proof
options.body: Close as fixed only if a maintainer can show current main or a shipped release delivering real reaction add/remove events in an equivalent multi-account setup.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction Report Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the reaction-specific tracker and request redacted live current-main envelopes, status output, and gateway trace logs before a code fix.
